methods.discovery: Read /sports, page /events using unfiltered market-closure state, league tag_id, end_date_min/max, order=id, ascending=true, limit=25 (two matched weekends) or 100 (whole season), then offset until a short page. Each archived response reported HTTP 200. Filter by series.id, soccer fixture prefix and team league plus explicit home/away ordering, dates and period. Join only full-game main and -more-markets events with identical normalized fixture slug, de-duplicate condition IDs across them.
methods.mapping: The complete 1X2 set needs three separate home win / draw / away win conditions, each with a Yes and a No token. Classify full-time totals and team totals using typed and named period/sides/line; accept only supported X.5 goals. Strict legacy questions on the main event can recover unlabeled moneylines. A condition requires a 32-byte hex ID and two distinct numeric outcome IDs bound to returned labels (declared version v1/clobTokenIds, v2/positionIds).
methods.windows: UTC left-closed right-open. Weekend denominators are the number of eligible main Gamma events; require matching slug date and UTC startTime in-window. No official fixture target denominator is implied for those two weekends.
methods.season: Anonymously paginate GET /events by the validated tag, limit=100 sorted by id asc across the July 2025-July 2026 delivery window, then join main/aux catalogue pairs to OpenFootball football.json 2025-26 regular league fixtures frozen at commit e6744429ee395bc86f247348c6184bb08d4eb361 by ordered home/away names (two explicit aliases) and event slug date. The stronger tier also requires the Gamma primary event startTime UTC date. Only full-time half-integer threshold contracts whose sides, 32-byte condition ID, and both outcome tokens rebind qualify. 1X2 requires all three distinct binaries. These counts describe post-season discovery at November 26 2026, not pregame availability, rules compatibility, historical executable depth or payout. Archive dates can reflect scheduling corrections. Missing evidence is kept explicit.
methods.order_books: First matching main game by UTC start+slug in the upcoming window for each league. Three 1X2 conditions; total at 2.5 and home/away at 1.5. Both outcome tokens individually read once. One call per outcome token. Require bound asset and condition, positive bids/asks and max(bid)<min(ask). Independent retrieval times are retained. Price ladders are not published.
methods.rules: Investigation only. In isolated process substitute the observed sport prefix in market_provider.FIXTURE; use unmodified normalized_markets and ledger_terms._interpret with original rule SHA/text, native event_teams and first outcome as token. Count only mapped half-line or full 1X2 contracts with paired token identities. This diagnostic checks recognition of full contract text, independently of depth, fees and authority to execute. No repository source changed.
methods.timestamps: Requested / received are UTC client observations. HTTP receipt times and response body SHA256 identify this observation. An identical request later can return different metadata or books. Historical metadata is not a pregame snapshot.
methods.indices: One family_group array = [three-condition 1X2, total, home_total, away_total]. All dates and ranges are UTC unless expressly labeled.

externally_adjudicated_cases.interpretation: Retain the archive discrepancy; use ruling publication clock and specific market payout rules/resolution for separate ledgers.

receipt_columns.repeat_page: Take list_url_at_offset_0 or gamma_url_at_offset_0 and replace offset=0 by that row offset.
